title: Internal formulation stability review: PARP inhibitor combination candidate
snippet: Internal stability review found the combination formulation candidate met 24-month shelf-life targets under accelerated storage conditions.

title: Internal PK/PD summary: SGLT2 inhibitor + antihypertensive combination
snippet: Internal PK/PD summary confirmed no clinically significant interaction between the SGLT2 inhibitor and antihypertensive agent at proposed combination doses.

title: Internal manufacturing note: metformin slow-release polymer matrix sourcing
snippet: Manufacturing note flags a secondary supplier qualification in progress for the polymer matrix used in the slow-release metformin formulation.

title: Internal cold-chain assessment: lyophilized antiviral formulation
snippet: Cold-chain assessment concluded the lyophilized formulation is stable at refrigerated temperatures for at least 18 months, supporting field deployment plans.
